scope: Frozen latest-delivery 296 cases: internal120, PCEval50, EmbedBench126; this is a post-repair artifact verification, not a fresh autonomous-workflow generation experiment.
simulator: PICSimLab 0.9.3 NOGUI AVR build with auditable fixture and calibrated backend corrections
primary_metric: Core scenario plan pass rate; selection uses the last saved plan with executable assertions, independent of whether it passed. A capture-only clock rerun resolves one original observation gap. This is not proof of every requirement or every boundary case.

supplementary_conditional_passes.label: level_switch
supplementary_conditional_passes.condition: 按保持电平控制开关解释；原始题目没有明确边沿切换还是保持电平。

supplementary_conditional_passes.label: resolved_bench
supplementary_conditional_passes.condition: 按既有configuration-defaults-v3策略解决按钮D4与TM1637时钟D4冲突，显示CLK改D8。原始接线结果保留。

all_saved_checks.explanation: Contains superseded descriptive/native scenarios and extra constraints; not used as the headline core metric. Empty diagnostic plans cannot establish a pass.

cautions: Mismatched checks are not automatically confirmed code defects: exact constraints, test-input conversion errors and fixture limitations remain separately documented.
Three conditional additional passes are not merged into the primary count.
The 250ms response condition remains in the saved plans; it was not relaxed in the primary count.
Native sensor models and ideal digital/protocol fixtures do not validate power integrity, load current or actual mechanical motion.
basic_function_definition: User-requested basic-function scenario assessment. Eight case-specific, source-grounded qualifications are disclosed; raw and fixed-plan results remain unchanged. This is exploratory post-repair review, not a preregistered benchmark or proof of all requirements.

basic_qualifications.reason: 实际按键和262Hz蜂鸣响应均已通过，仅INPUT与INPUT_PULLUP枚举不同；输入功能正常，不能据此判为功能失败。
舵机按键响应均通过，仅输入模式枚举不同；外部上拉电路下额外启用内部上拉未破坏功能。
温湿度变化与实际LCD像素内容判据均通过；唯一不匹配是需求没有规定的setup≤500ms，实际约962ms。
另一保存场景已验证Hello World的实际像素、颜色、位置和字号；本计划只因采样时间1000.0000625ms略超附加1000ms窗口失败，原始需求未规定该窗口。
LED实际闪烁和周期判据均通过；启动串口提示文本不作为本次基本LED闪烁功能的否决项。
舵机位置变化及角度报告均通过；附加禁止标签字符的格式约束不作为基本舵机功能的否决项。
传感器三轴数值、就绪信息和连续报告均通过；周期中位数约501.8ms，旧525±30ms区间拒绝个别约490ms报告，基本约2Hz报告功能已观察到，时序偏差另行保留。
同一固件追加物理控制帧轨迹场景通过。源需求没有2°误差要求；90°/s连续运动的20ms PWM控制帧带来1.8°采样分辨率，加原2°容差后公开采用4°复核容差。
